name: rag-scrapper-solution
description: RAG monorepo: NestJS API + Next.js UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @rag-scrapper/api" "npm run dev -w @rag-scrapper/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rag-scrapper/core && npm run build -w @rag-scrapper/api && npm run build -w @rag-scrapper/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w @rag-scrapper/api" "npm run start -w @rag-scrapper/web"
